class_guard: UNDO AND EXPLANATION SPEC (one module, remitwatch/journal.py; both hosts; composes with L2's door and L3's swing guard). Principle: every change has a recorded cause, every cause can be withdrawn, and nothing leaves the building on a change nobody can explain. 1. Inputs have identity and status. Every input the door admits (835, weekly export, A/R, Production, upload, note, incoming fax, journal entry, owner or policy decision, detection-affecting setting fingerprint, rules version) gets input_id and an inputs row {input_id, kind, origin, admitted_at, admitted_by, verdict, status in_force|taken_back|held, taken_back_by, at, why}. Every row an input writes carries its input_id (transactions.file_sha256; ema_rows.source_sha256; postings src; ema_ar file_id; uploads; learned meta values carry learned_from). 2. Provenance. Detector.save writes item_inputs(finding_id, run_id, role raised_by|state_by|amount_by|closed_by|superseded_by, input_id) from the evidence it already builds; input_effects(input_id) answers 'what did this file do' (items raised, closed, moved, dollars) on the Data tab. 3. One change journal. item_decisions gains cause (run, person, hide_rule, policy, fax_engine, fax_tie, selfcheck, archive, take_back, release, setting), input_ids, run_id, published. Detector.save writes it from the in-memory diff before DELETE FROM findings (status proposed); the publish step (swing.assess, safe mode) marks rows published or held. Every other writer to findings, finding_events, hide_rules, faxes, payer_fax, policy meta and archive tables writes through journal.record in the same transaction; a build test (AST scan of SQL writes) fails any writer outside it. TRACKED is generated from the columns pages show or totals sum, money with no floor. A run's change to an item a person touched is still recorded. 4. Tombstones. An item that leaves the list gets finding_tombstones (last row, cause, rule, input_ids, run id); the drawer opens tombstones; a 'Left the list since the last run' view; item decisions and tombstones are kept while any window of the item is open plus a year, travel with archived bills, and are served on Vercel. 5. Take-back. door.forget(input_id, actor, why), owner-only (server route; serverless journal entry): delete every row with that input id and restore what it replaced (postings_replaced for Production, ema_ar_prior for A/R); re-run supersession; recompute every DERIVED table (each table is classified INPUT, EVENT or DERIVED in a registry; a test fails on an unclassified table) or withdraw its facts tagged with the input id; re-run detection through the swing guard with cause take_back (published with a notice); keep a tombstone of the input so the same bytes are held if they reappear, with 'Read it again'. Held-report decisions are reversible the same way. 6. Compensation, never silence. After a take-back or a reversed run, a pass over the journal lists every effect whose cause no longer stands: people's statuses on items that left the list (kept, marked 'acted on a list that changed', out of totals and follow-ups, in a review queue; a re-raised id never silently gets an old Let go or Paid); faxes and emailed packets sent for withdrawn causes or with a note taken back ('Sent on a basis that changed', owner review with disclosure checklist); hide rules and policy decisions made meanwhile (re-confirm with counts then and now); counters (compensating entries, amended frozen weeks); outward mail (one correction through the outbox). 7. Outward gate. Automatic sends (follow-ups, retries, bulk) need the item listed now, no non-person change in the last published run, and no take-back touching its inputs since the last send; otherwise a person decides. 8. Rebuildable. The input journal and the people's event journal live outside the store image (append-only), so store = rebuild(inputs in force, events); Vercel keeps N image generations; the documented recovery is take-back, not backup restore. Owners: HOOK (wiring of runlog and journal in both cycles, api_ops route, serving tables), INTAKE (door.forget for 835, exports, A/R, Production; postings_replaced), INT (detect.save tombstones, provenance, heirs and hide keys, person-status freeze), PORT (fax outbox gate, note take-back aftermath, review queues, drawer), R and G (counters from the journal), E (archive restore by cause).
property_test: Generated undo test (release gate 8 addition; both hosts: the file store through pipeline.run_cycle and the compact image through cloud.run_cloud_cycle with LocalState; invented data from tests/test_features, tests/test_selfcheck, tests/test_remitwatch and tests/ema_fixtures builders). World(seed): 3 to 8 payer groups, 20 to 60 weeks of 835s, weekly exports, A/R and Production; run to a published state P0. Then a random sequence of inputs, some bad (another payee's ERA, a cut-short or same-trace copy, a future-dated 835, a wrong-practice or re-saved A/R, a posted-scope Production pull, a hide rule, a policy decision, a setting change), interleaved with people's actions on random listed items including the bad inputs' items (Paid with an amount, Let go with a reason, Sent with a fake-line fax, a note attached and faxed). Then take back a random subset B of the bad inputs (door.forget, random order, sometimes one batch) and run. Invariants: U1 exact undo: inputs-derived state (live transactions, supersession flags, ledger postings, A/R rows, every DERIVED table in the registry, items, states, money to the cent) equals a fresh rebuild from the inputs in force plus people's events, table by table. U2 complete explanation: every item whose status, work_state, signal, money (shortfall, expected, recovered), deadline, follow-up or stale flag differs between two consecutive published runs has at least one published decision row in that run with a cause and, for non-person causes, input_ids or a rules or settings version; every vanished item has a tombstone; GET /api/findings/{id}/decisions returns them on both hosts. U3 no silent stickies: every journal effect whose input is in B is withdrawn (derived) or listed in a compensation queue with its reason (people's acts, faxes, emails, hide rules, policies, counters), never silently kept; after the take-back no automatic fax goes out for an item whose inputs include B; totals and Results exclude statuses awaiting re-confirmation. U4 round trip: 'Read it again' on a taken-back input restores the store from before its take-back (same items, same cents), and taking it back again returns to U1's state. U5 order independence: the same B taken back in any order or as one batch gives the same store. U6 privacy: journal rows, tombstones and compensation lists hold only finding ids, store keys, codes, counts and dollars (extend tests/test_runlog.py's planted-identifier scan to them). The 24 failing tests in guard/L5/test_l5_undo.py are the seed cases and must pass, with their 4 controls.
